test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are seven friends who scored different marks in the periodic test. C scored less than 2 persons. B scored more than C but less than A. E scored more than F but less than D. F has not scored the least. How many people scored between C and G?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are seven friends.

1) C scored less than 2 persons.

__ > __ > C > __ > __ > __ > __

2) B scored more than C but less than A.

A > B > C > __ > __ > __ > __

3) E scored more than F but less than D.

4) F has not scored the least.

A > B > C > D > E > F > G

Here, there are three person 'D, E, F' who scored between C and G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
